entries.4d2488c1b906cf16: Its core wiper blade rubber business has put in place a solutions business structure that can propose not only the shape of the rubber but also design specifications for the components on the wiper system side, and its global share of wiper blade rubber has expanded from 50% in fiscal 2024 to 58%. Its know-how in design, prototyping, evaluation and mass production, cultivated through manufacturing since its founding, is also a strength.

entries.cb5d2c72379f4ed5: The New Medium-Term Management Plan 2026, formulated in June 2023 (final year: fiscal year ended March 2027), further advances the structural improvements made until then (production process rationalization, reduction of defects and streamlining of indirect operations); its strategic scheme aims to maximize earnings power through two pillars, 'strengthening existing businesses' and 'expanding growth and new businesses', together with 'reform of the management foundation with emphasis on each ESG perspective'. For the fiscal year ending March 2027, it sets 'building a solid business foundation for sustainable growth' as its top priority, and states that the next medium-term management plan aims at sustainable growth and enhancement of corporate value, centered on strengthening earning power.
